label: Every actual distinct esse is efficiently caused (CAUSING_AN_EFFECT_6) by another being in act
paraphrase: Analyst formulation of the efficient reading of ST I q.3 a.4 co., first proof ('habeat esse causatum ab alio'), attribution deferred: for every x that actually exists with esse distinct from its essence (DistinctEsseAt), some y other than x (numerical distinctness only) is in act as to being, causes x's esse (CausesIn y x esse) and is an efficient cause of x's esse (EfficientlyCausesEsse y x, the tenseless agent-cause primitive, CAUSING_AN_EFFECT_6). The passage's conclusion does not name the mode of causing; the efficient reading is suggested by its context (the fire-heating-water example and 'quia Deum dicimus esse primam causam efficientem') and is not stated. It strengthens STMT-DISTINCT-ESSE-REQUIRES-EXTERNAL-CAUSE (the same conclusion with the mode unspecified). Tenseless: no present sustaining, conservation, world-indexed existence, uniqueness or God identification is asserted.
